namespace Pipeline.Generated

/-!
POSIX `dirname`: print the directory portion of the single PATH operand.
The classic step algorithm, on the reversed character list so that
`dropWhile` from the front edits the end of the pathname:
  * string entirely of '/' characters (they are all leading) -> "/",
    empty string -> "."
  * step 3: remove trailing '/' characters
  * step 4: no '/' remaining -> "."
  * steps 5 and 7: remove the final component, then trailing '/' again
  * step 8: everything consumed -> "/"
-/

/-- Trailing slashes stripped, then the final component, then trailing
    slashes again: the parent, still reversed. -/
def parentRev (cs : List Char) : List Char :=
  ((cs.reverse.dropWhile (· == '/')).dropWhile (fun c => !(c == '/'))).dropWhile (· == '/')

def dirCore (cs : List Char) : List Char :=
  if cs.all (· == '/') then
    if cs.isEmpty then ['.'] else ['/']
  else if (cs.reverse.dropWhile (· == '/')).any (· == '/') then
    if (parentRev cs).isEmpty then ['/'] else (parentRev cs).reverse
  else
    ['.']

def dirname (s : String) : String := String.ofList (dirCore s.toList)

def run (args stdin : List String) : List String × UInt32 :=
  match args with
  | [p] => ([dirname p], 0)
  | _ => ([], 1)

/-! ### Helper lemmas -/

theorem not_mem_dropWhile_of_not_mem {p : Char → Bool} {a : Char}
    {l : List Char} (h : a ∉ l) : a ∉ l.dropWhile p :=
  fun hmem => h ((List.dropWhile_sublist p).mem hmem)

theorem any_slash_eq_false {l : List Char} (h : '/' ∉ l) :
    l.any (· == '/') = false := by
  rw [List.any_eq_false]
  intro x hx hbeq
  rw [beq_iff_eq] at hbeq
  exact h (hbeq ▸ hx)

theorem dirCore_no_slash {cs : List Char} (h : '/' ∉ cs) :
    dirCore cs = ['.'] := by
  cases cs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c cs' =>
    have hc : c ≠ '/' := fun hEq => h (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl hEq.symm))
    have hall : ((c :: cs').all (· == '/')) = false := by simp [hc]
    have hmem : '/' ∉ (c :: cs').reverse := fun hm => h (List.mem_reverse.mp hm)
    have hany : (((c :: cs').reverse.dropWhile (· == '/')).any (· == '/')) = false :=
      any_slash_eq_false (not_mem_dropWhile_of_not_mem hmem)
    unfold dirCore
    rw [hall, hany]
    simp

theorem dirCore_all_slash {cs : List Char} (hne : cs ≠ [])
    (h : ∀ c ∈ cs, c = '/') : dirCore cs = ['/'] := by
  have hall : cs.all (· == '/') = true := by
    rw [List.all_eq_true]
    intro x hx
    exact beq_iff_eq.mpr (h x hx)
  have hempty : cs.isEmpty = false := by
    cases cs with
    | nil => exact absurd rfl hne
    | cons _ _ => rfl
  unfold dirCore
  rw [hall, hempty]
  simp

/-! ### Spec theorems -/

/-- STDOUT: dirname writes exactly one line for one operand. -/
theorem run_output_length (p : String) (stdin : List String) :
    ((run [p] stdin).1).length = 1 := rfl

/-- EXIT STATUS: successful completion returns 0 for one operand. -/
theorem run_exit_success (p : String) (stdin : List String) :
    (run [p] stdin).2 = 0 := rfl

/-- STDIN: not used; the result never depends on standard input. -/
theorem run_stdin_ignored (args s₁ s₂ : List String) :
    run args s₁ = run args s₂ := by
  cases args with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a rest => cases rest <;> rfl

/-- EXIT STATUS: anything other than exactly one operand is an error (>0),
    with nothing on stdout. -/
theorem run_wrong_arity (args stdin : List String) (h : args.length ≠ 1) :
    run args stdin = ([], 1) := by
  match args with
  | [] => rfl
  | [_] => exact absurd rfl h
  | _ :: _ :: _ => rfl

/-- DESCRIPTION: if the pathname does not contain a '/' (this includes the
    empty string), the resulting string is ".". -/
theorem run_no_slash_dot (p : String) (stdin : List String)
    (h : '/' ∉ p.toList) : (run [p] stdin).1 = ["."] := by
  show [dirname p] = ["."]
  unfold dirname
  rw [dirCore_no_slash h]

/-- DESCRIPTION: trailing slashes that are also leading slashes are kept, so a
    nonempty pathname made only of '/' characters yields "/". -/
theorem run_all_slash_root (p : String) (stdin : List String)
    (hne : p.toList ≠ []) (h : ∀ c ∈ p.toList, c = '/') :
    (run [p] stdin).1 = ["/"] := by
  show [dirname p] = ["/"]
  unfold dirname
  rw [dirCore_all_slash hne h]

end Pipeline.Generated

spec_theorems.name: run_output_length
spec_theorems.informal: STDOUT: dirname writes exactly one line to standard output for one operand.

spec_theorems.name: run_exit_success
spec_theorems.informal: EXIT STATUS: successful completion with one operand returns exit code 0.

spec_theorems.name: run_stdin_ignored
spec_theorems.informal: STDIN: not used; the result is independent of standard input.

spec_theorems.name: run_wrong_arity
spec_theorems.informal: EXIT STATUS: any argument count other than exactly one operand is an error, exiting >0 with no stdout.

spec_theorems.name: run_no_slash_dot
spec_theorems.informal: DESCRIPTION: if the pathname contains no '/' (including the empty string), the resulting string is ".".

spec_theorems.name: run_all_slash_root
spec_theorems.informal: DESCRIPTION: trailing slashes that are also leading slashes are kept, so a nonempty pathname consisting only of '/' characters yields "/".
